description: This Is What We Offer You Salary: Gross monthly salary between EUR 5,994 and EUR 8,563 (scale 10) for a 36-hour work week. Extras: a thirteenth month, 8% holiday allowance, and a 10% Employee Benefit Budget. Development budget: EUR 1,400 development budget per year for your growth and development. Hybrid working: a balance between home and office work (possible for most roles). Pension: decide for yourself the amount of your personal contribution. Or view all our benefits. Help shape the digital service experience for thousands of Rabobank colleagues: making IT Service Management simpler, smarter and more valuable every day. Within Consumer Data, part of the Tech4Engineering Tribe, we enable Rabobank teams to find, use and improve IT4IT information in a simple, reliable and compliant way. As Product Owner IT Service Management, you set the product direction for our ITSM platform and turn user needs into solutions that help colleagues work with more clarity, speed and confidence. This is a role for someone who brings product thinking into a complex environment. You do not need to be the deepest technical expert; your strength lies in understanding what users need, connecting people, making clear choices and translating complexity into a roadmap that creates visible impact. You work closely with (Delegated) Process Owners, business stakeholders, IT Risk, Security, Architecture, DevOps squads and our platform vendor Halo. Together, you make ITSM processes such as Incident, Problem, Request, Change and Configuration Management more intuitive, scalable and compliant - so teams across Rabobank can focus on delivering value for customers. You & your role As Product Owner IT Service Management, you take ownership of the product vision, roadmap and backlog for Rabobank’s managed ITSM platform. You actively engage with users and stakeholders to understand pain points, identify opportunities and set priorities based on customer value, business impact, compliance requirements and delivery capacity. You are the person who brings focus: what problem are we solving, who are we solving it for and how will we know it works? By simplifying user journeys, strengthening governance and improving adoption, you help make the platform easier to use and more effective for colleagues across Rabobank. You form a triangle with the IT Lead and the Solution Architect. Product direction is yours; technology is theirs, and together you set the course for the platform. Because the platform is vendor-managed and cloud-based, your focus is not on infrastructure or system lifecycle management. Instead, you guide product direction, align stakeholders, translate processes into practical solutions and drive continuous improvement. Top 3 responsibilities Shape the product vision, roadmap and backlog Define and maintain a clear product direction for the IT Service Management. Prioritise work based on user needs, business value, compliance expectations and delivery feasibility, and make the roadmap understandable for both business and technology stakeholders. Drive stakeholder alignment and decision-making Build strong relationships across business, IT, risk, security, architecture, process ownership and vendor management. Facilitate conversations, create shared understanding and help stakeholders make well-founded decisions that move the product forward. Improve user adoption and product value Continuously improve how colleagues work with the ITSM platform. Identify pain points, simplify processes, improve documentation and ensure that the platform supports teams in working efficiently, consistently and compliantly. Work on yourself and the world around you at the same time For us, your development and that of society go hand in hand. That’s why we want to invest in you and work together for a better world. We summarise this in one sentence: ‘At Rabobank, you work on yourself and the world around you at the same time. You’ll see this reflected in your personal development budget, our hybrid working environment, and a healthy balance between work and home. You can work on banking services for our private and business customers, as well as societal issues such as food and energy transitions. Why everyone is welcome at Rabobank At Rabobank, we believe we become stronger through people who complement each other. By embracing our differences, we bring out the best in one another. We seek diversity in areas such as knowledge, skills, and experience, but also in gender, background, and culture. Across every department, we strive for variety and the freedom to be yourself – whoever you are. That’s what diversity and inclusion at Rabobank is all about You & your talent You combine product ownership with curiosity, structure and a talent for bringing people together. You know how to create clarity when interests differ, and you are energised by improving products that help colleagues do their work better. You bring: Experience as a Product Owner, Product Manager, Business Product Owner, Project Lead or in a comparable role where you translated needs into direction, priorities and outcomes. Strong product thinking: you can define user problems, value propositions, priorities and measurable results. Excellent stakeholder management skills and the ability to build trust across teams with different perspectives and priorities. The ability to prioritise based on customer value, business impact, risk, compliance and delivery capacity. Curiosity about IT Service Management, platform products and process improvement — and the motivation to keep learning in this space. The ability to work with DevOps squads and translate stakeholder needs into clear backlog items, acceptance criteria and desired outcomes. Nice to have Experience with IT Service Management processes such as Incident, Problem, Change, Request or Configuration Management. Experience with ITSM platforms such as Halo, ServiceNow or similar tooling. Experience in a regulated environment where compliance, risk and security are important. Understanding of ITIL principles. How to apply To ensure that we assess all candidates equally for suitability for this position, we do not require a mandatory cover letter. Instead, we ask all candidates the same three questions to see how your profile matches the role. It takes a little more of your time and gives us both a much better basis for deciding. Please pay sufficient attention to answering these questions and explaining your answers; together with your CV, these responses form the basis for our evaluation in this round. Submitting both a CV and answers to the three questions is the minimum requirement to be considered in the selection process. A cover letter is not mandatory but may be submitted optionally. You may draw on your work experience, volunteer work, education, private life, and so on. Use a maximum of 200 words per question and provide no more than two examples. Below are the questions: Describe a backlog or product you inherited that was in worse shape than you expected. What did you do in the first month, and what did you deliberately choose not to do? Tell us about a time you had to say no to a stakeholder who outranked you. How did you handle it, and where did the relationship end up? How do you decide what not to do when everything is urgent and someone credible is asking for each of them? Describe a product decision you got wrong. How did you find out, and what changed in the way you work afterwards? Please submit these answers in the application section titled 'Add your cover letter (optional)' on the website portal. You & the application process You can apply for the Product Owner – IT Service Management vacancy at Rabobank, until fulfilment. Questions about working at Rabobank and the process? Ashley Lumbantobing, IT Recruiter via ashley.lumbantobing@rabobank.nl If you are invited for an interview, Bo, our virtual assistant, will contact you via SMS and email to schedule it. For the second-round interview, candidates will be asked to deliver a 10-minute presentation outlining a product they own (or have owned), the problem it solves, their role, key decisions taken, results achieved, and key learnings. Answers to frequently asked questions can be found at Rabobank rabobank.jobs/en/faq A reliability check is part of the procedure. We respect your privacy. To be considered for this position, you must be located in the Netherlands and have the legal right to work in the Netherlands. We are unable to consider candidates requiring relocation from another country.
title: Product Owner – IT Service Management

description: This isn’t your regular job. Almedia is a place where those who want to push harder can accelerate their careers faster than anywhere else. We’re aiming to become Germany’s second bootstrapped unicorn. Almedia is already Europe’s #3 fastest-growing company in 2025 (FT1000). We are building the future of marketing by rewarding our community of over 70 million users for engaging with our advertisers’ products. We are offering a new way to acquire users for the biggest companies in the world. At Almedia, You’ll Own way more, way earlier — you’ll be trusted with responsibility fast. Push harder, get further — this isn’t a 9–5. We highly reward intensity. Join a rare environment — you will work with ambitious high-speed, high-ownership people. Fully present — we’re 5 days a week in the office to build the energising momentum we need. Senior Growth Manager (Berlin) Salary Range: €45K – €75K Offers Equity Offers Bonus At a Glance You'll own a real book of business. There is a sales and account-management motion. The size of the responsibility comes from top-line ownership. Quota chasing is not the job. You shape the work and execute it. What You’ll Do 🎯 Own a book of 5–15 advertiser accounts end-to-end. You'll be the person behind the growth. The one advertisers ask when something breaks. The one our Director checks in with when an account spikes. Grow the revenue line. You are measured on the top-line you grow, not on activity. You communicate clearly, you drive yourself without being managed, and you stay open-minded when the data proves you wrong. Run the ROAS dial. With guidance from senior team members, tune Almedia's internal ROAS (Return on Ad Spend) targets per offer, geo, and OS, often hourly. Use Hex (or comparable SQL-notebook tool), Amplitude, Looker Studio, and Almedia's internal Freecash AI every working day. Develop a proactive account instinct. You'll work toward spotting issues before they become problems, push budget increases, geo expansions, and format tests on a rhythm. You'll learn to intervene before a metric becomes a complaint. Bridge commercial and technical teams. When partners flag issues, you'll debug, coordinate with engineering, and communicate back clearly to the partner. Contribute to the playbook. Help document process improvements as you learn. Your fresh perspective is an asset. What your first 90 days look like Days 1–30: Shadow our Senior Growth Managers on their account calls. Take over 2 small accounts (sub-€10K daily spend) and learn the backbone of our growth engine hands-on. Days 31–60: Take over a full book of 5–10 accounts. Own your first KPI review with our a senior team member. Contribute with your first written process improvement. Days 61–90: Operating with increasing independence. You've caught at least one issue before it escalated and proposed a test or lever on your book. Beyond 90 days: A clear path from Growth Manager to Senior Growth Manager to Strategic Growth Lead and beyond. Salary and equity scale with each step. What You’ll Bring 💡 You're hungry and looking for a challenge. You want to build and own real outcomes, not collect a title. You have some professional experience, have had to figure things out independently and you liked it. You tell stories with data. You read the numbers, then you tell their story. You don't need to be a data scientist, but you should be able to open a dashboard, spot something off, and ask the right questions. You're bilingual in the best sense, equally fluent and comfortable talking commercial with advertisers and technical with algorithm teams in the same day. Bonus Points If You Have some exposure to performance marketing metrics like ROAS, LTV, retention, or ARPU. If not, we'll get you there by week 2. Have managed a book of advertiser or partner accounts in performance marketing, mobile gaming UA, or rewarded UA. If not, we're more than willing to develop you into that role. Have used tools like AppsFlyer, Adjust, or Singular, or want to learn. Have built and grown a book of business in a measurable way. Top-tier consulting (MBB) or scale-up background. We hire the for right thoughts. Rewarded-UA depth comes in your first 60 days. Have actually used Hex, worked inside the admin of a rewarded UA platform, or been on the advertiser side of one. What Makes You a Great Fit 🌟 Own Everything: Get It Done. When an advertiser drops 28 action items into your channel on Monday, you don't escalate. You triage, batch, and ship the 10 that matter by Friday. You don't ask for permission to fix obvious things. Take Initiative: Be Proactive. You spot the geo where the cap consistently under-fills. You ask the algo team why. You propose the test. You don't wait for someone to assign it. Move Fast: Start Simple, Iterate Quickly. You'd rather change the ROAS target today on incomplete data, watch for 7–14 days, and learn. Not wait two weeks for a perfect read. You know the stabilisation window. You don't tune at hour 3. You also don't drift past day 14 without a verdict. Focus on Impact: Deliver What's Most Important. You'd rather move €500K of monthly spend on the top account than €50K across five small ones. You know which accounts are load-bearing. Raise the Bar: Have High Standards. When something is sub-optimal, you fix it AND document it, so the next person inherits a better one. You hold the line on quality even when it would be easier not to. Why Almedia? 🎁 Own Our Growth: We offer all Berlin-based employees equity in Almedia to truly be a part of our success. Scale With Almedia: Grow alongside a startup that has been profitable from day one. Central Berlin Office: Work from a fully-stocked modern office built for collaboration, accessible from all around Berlin. Other Benefits: Transport subsidy, breakfasts and lunches, language learning, Urban Sports Club, and more. We believe in fostering talent, evaluating all skill levels during the hiring process, and providing a clear path for growth. Almedia is an equal opportunity employer. We embrace and celebrate diversity, and encourage individuals from all backgrounds to apply.
title: Growth Manager (Berlin)

description: In Deutschland geben Patienten jährlich 30 Milliarden EUR beim Zahnarzt aus. Trotz dieser Marktgröße arbeiten viele Praxen noch immer mit veralteter Offline-Software aus den 80er Jahren. Roger ist hier, um das zu ändern. Unsere Mission: Zahnarztpraxen mit unserem virtuellen KI-Assistenten Roger zu revolutionieren. Unsere Software transformiert Behandlungsplanung und Patientenkommunikation, steigert Effizienz und Umsatz und vereinfacht den Praxisalltag für Zahnärzt:innen und ihre Teams. In dieser Rolle verantwortest du das Product Backlog und die operative Umsetzung der Roadmap bei Roger. Du arbeitest eng mit dem Entwicklungsteam, dem Gründer/CEO und unseren Nutzer:innen zusammen und übersetzt Produktstrategie in konkrete, priorisierte Anforderungen – damit das Team die richtigen Dinge zur richtigen Zeit liefert. Aufgaben Product Backlog verantworten: Du pflegst, priorisierst und verfeinerst das Backlog und sorgst dafür, dass es jederzeit die wichtigsten Wertbeiträge abbildet. Roadmap in Umsetzung bringen: Du übersetzt die gemeinsam mit Gründer/CEO entwickelte Produktstrategie in klare User Stories, Akzeptanzkriterien und Sprint-Ziele. Time-to-Market sicherstellen: In enger Abstimmung mit Engineering sorgst du für eine effiziente Umsetzung und schnelle, verlässliche Auslieferung neuer Features. Features zur Optimierung des Praxisalltags konzipieren: Du entwickelst neue Features, die den Arbeitsalltag in Arztpraxen spürbar erleichtern – von der Idee bis zum Release. Praxisverwaltungssysteme (PMS) verstehen und analysieren: Du analysierst bestehende Praxisverwaltungssysteme und leitest daraus Anforderungen ab (inkl. Reverse Engineering von Datenstrukturen und Workflows). Datenabgleich und Nutzerfeedback einholen: Über den Abgleich von Datenstrukturen mittels SQL und direktes Nutzerfeedback gestaltest du praxisnahe, bedarfsgerechte Lösungen. Ein Verständnis der medizinischen Realität hilft dir, passgenaue Features zu entwickeln. Als Kommunikationsschnittstelle zwischen Business und Technik agieren: Du bist das Bindeglied zwischen Nutzer:innen, Stakeholdern und Engineering und kommunizierst Prioritäten klar in beide Richtungen. Qualifikation Erfahrung als Product Owner, Product Manager oder in einer vergleichbaren Rolle in einem Healthtech Startup / Scale-up - idealerweise in der Zahnmedizin. Sicherer Umgang mit agilen Methoden (Scrum/Kanban) und Backlog-Management. Du nutzt KI-Tools selbstverständlich in deiner täglichen Arbeit und suchst aktiv nach Wegen, Produkt und Prozesse damit besser und schneller zu machen. Du verstehst, wie sich KI sinnvoll in Produkte einbauen lässt und wo sie echten Nutzen stiftet statt nur draufzusitzen. Du verfolgst neue KI-Entwicklungen aktiv und bringst Ideen ein, wie wir sie bei Roger einsetzen können (AI-pilled / AI-First-Mentalität). Gutes technisches Verständnis, um Produktanforderungen präzise an das Engineering-Team weiterzugeben. Wachstumsdrang / Growth Mindset: Tiefe Verpflichtung zu persönlichem und beruflichem Wachstum, offen für Feedback und neue Lernmöglichkeiten. Persönliche Fähigkeiten: analytisches und strukturiertes Arbeiten, Eigeninitiative, selbstständige Problemlösung, Lernbereitschaft und Freude an der Arbeit im Team. Abgeschlossenes Studium, idealerweise im medizinischen, wirtschaftlichen oder IT-Bereich. Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse. Nice to have SQL-Kenntnisse BigQuery Erste Führungserfahrung Benefits Lebendige Kultur: Tauche ein in eine Kultur mit tatsächlich flachen Hirarchien, die Innovation, Teamarbeit und Spaß bei der Arbeit feiert. Karrierechance Bewirb Dich jetzt bei Roger und teile uns Dein frühestmögliches Startdatum mit. Wir können es kaum erwarten, Dich kennen zu lernen und Dein Potenzial zu entfesseln! Falls du nicht alle geforderten Erfahrungen mitbringst – kein Problem! Wenn du motiviert bist und Lust hast, dich im Bereich Product Management weiterzuentwickeln, freuen wir uns trotzdem auf deine Bewerbung.
title: Product Owner - Healthtech (m/w/d)

description: Because we strive to put people first. Culture, our way. Technology at Primark What’s a career at Primark all about? The positive impact you’re making, the experiences you’re having and the people you’re with. You’re our inspiration. Embrace what sets you apart, own your career and develop in ways you never expected. Leave your mark. And do it your way. Our technology team is actively seeking an Associate Product Owner (APO) to join Primark Technology’s transformation journey. In this role, you will own a mature product or a portfolio of smaller products, working alongside senior Product Owners and Product Managers to translate strategy into clear roadmaps and prioritised backlogs. You will ensure delivery teams build the right solutions at the right time to deliver measurable value. This opportunity is ideal for Project Managers, Business Analysts or Delivery Leads looking to expand their responsibilities across the full product lifecycle and progress towards end-to-end product ownership. What You’ll Get This role is a hybrid opportunity, offering 2-3 days Working from office. People are at the heart of what we do here, so it’s essential we provide you with the right environment to perform at your very best. Let’s talk lifestyle: Healthcare, pension and potential bonus. 27 days of leave, plus bank holidays and if you want, you can buy 5 more. Because Primark is all about tailoring to you we offer Tax Saver Tickets, fitness centre and a subsidised cafeteria. What You’ll Do as Associate Product Owner In your role, you’ll collaborate with different people across a range of skillsets. Here’s a flavour of your day-to-day: Own the end-to-end product lifecycle from discovery and design through development, optimisation and operational support. Define, maintain and prioritise the product backlog, ensuring alignment with business objectives, customer needs and strategic priorities. Create and manage user stories, requirements and acceptance criteria to enable clear and effective delivery. Use customer, colleague, market and data insights to prioritise features and enhancements based on value, business impact and cost efficiency. Lead sprint and release planning, manage cross-team dependencies and drive continuous delivery and product improvements. Communicate progress, risks and opportunities to stakeholders, support product adoption, ensure compliance with governance frameworks and provide an excellent opportunity for Project Managers, Business Analysts and Delivery Leads to broaden their experience across the full product lifecycle and progress into end-to-end product ownership. What You’ll Bring Here at Primark, we want everyone to feel valued – so please bring your authentic self to work, of course with some other key experience and abilities for this role in particular: Experience in technology delivery, product management, delivery management, or business analysis. Understanding of backlog and roadmap management with experience working in multidisciplinary delivery teams. Experience writing user stories and business requirements to support successful product delivery. Knowledge of Agile frameworks such as Scrum or SAFe and an understanding of product management practices. Strong analytical and strategic thinking skills with the ability to balance cost, value, and customer experience while identifying business opportunities from emerging technologies. Excellent stakeholder engagement and communication skills with the ability to influence business partners, suppliers, technical teams and non-technical stakeholders across global delivery teams. Does this sound like you? Great, because we can’t wait to see what you’ll bring. You’ll be supported within a team of equally capable people, celebrating who you are and aiding you reach your potential. At Primark, we’re excited about our future - and we’re excited to develop yours. About Primark At Primark, people matter. They’re the beating heart of our business and the reason we’ve grown from our first store in Dublin in 1969 to over 80,000 colleagues and over 480 stores in 18 countries today and growing. So, what’s a career at Primark all about? The positive impact you’re making, the experiences you’re having and the people you’re with. It’s that feeling that turns a job into something more. Celebrating the wins, working at pace, and pulling through the challenging times with passion, courage, and your team by your side. It’s what drives us every day. You’re our driving force. Embrace what sets you apart, own your career and develop in ways you never expected. Leave your mark. And do it your way. REQ ID: JR-12936
title: Associate Product Owner

description: Business Analyst – Technology Change & Process Improvement Dublin Albany Beck is looking for a driven and commercially minded Business Analyst to join our consulting team and support a leading financial services organisation as it delivers a series of operational and technology-driven change initiatives. This assignment sits at the intersection of business process improvement, technology adoption and stakeholder engagement. You'll be joining a team that values people who take ownership, solve problems proactively and keep momentum behind key initiatives. Rather than stepping into a highly structured programme environment, you'll be expected to bring your own approach, shape the way work is delivered and help create clarity where processes and governance are still evolving. The Role Working across business and technology teams, you will help improve and modernise operational processes, ensuring that both people and technology are aligned to deliver better outcomes. You'll spend time understanding how teams operate today, identifying inefficiencies, defining future-state processes and helping embed new ways of working. Alongside this, you'll work closely with stakeholders to ensure technology solutions are delivering the intended business value and are successfully adopted by end users. This is a role for someone who enjoys being in the middle of the action—engaging stakeholders, solving challenges, influencing decisions and driving progress. Key Responsibilities Analyse existing operational processes and identify opportunities for improvement. Define and document business requirements, process flows and future-state solutions. Partner with technology teams to ensure solutions align with business objectives. Facilitate workshops and discussions to gather information, build consensus and support decision-making. Coordinate activities across multiple stakeholder groups to maintain delivery momentum. Support implementation, rollout and adoption of new processes and technology capabilities. Challenge existing ways of working and help shape more efficient operating models. Track actions, dependencies and risks to ensure initiatives remain on course. Build strong relationships with stakeholders across business and technology functions. What We're Looking For We're interested in speaking with Business Analysts who combine strong core BA skills with the confidence and initiative to lead workstreams forward. Key Experience: Experience delivering business analysis on technology or transformation programmes. Strong process mapping and requirements gathering capabilities. The ability to translate business needs into clear, structured documentation. Experience working alongside technology teams on system implementations or enhancements. Excellent stakeholder engagement and communication skills. A pragmatic and delivery-focused approach to problem solving. The confidence to engage with senior stakeholders and influence outcomes.
title: Business Analyst – Technology Change & Process Improvement

description: Professional Competencies and Skills The ideal candidate demonstrates: Proven Business Analysis experience within complex data-driven environments. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate business requirements into implementable solutions. Experience with enterprise data warehouses, reporting environments, and large-scale data transformations. Ability to develop conceptual, logical, and business process models. Experience working in Agile product teams alongside Product Managers and Engineers. Strong stakeholder management and facilitation skills. Knowledge of organisational master data, hierarchy management, and reporting structures. Ability to challenge solutions constructively and provide well-founded recommendations. Excellent communication skills and ability to bridge business and technology domains. Preferred Experience experience as a Business Analyst, Data Analyst, or related role. Experience with ServiceNow and Portfolio Management data. Experience within financial reporting and management information environments. Familiarity with Azure-based data platforms and modern data architectures. Experience supporting organisational transformations or large-scale operating model changes. Expected Results / Deliverables The Business Analyst will be accountable for: Impact assessments covering all data flows affected by the new Delivery Organisation. Validated business and data requirements. Updated conceptual and functional designs supporting organisational hierarchy changes. Recommendations and guidance for data migration and transition activities. Alignment between business stakeholders and engineering teams throughout implementation. Successful testing and validation of implemented solutions. Stakeholder workshops and decision-making sessions resulting in agreed outcomes. Support for a smooth transition with minimal disruption to reporting and financial capabilities
title: Business Analyst

description: Job Title: Business Systems Analyst Location: Medguard Head Office Reporting to: Head of Commercial Marketing and Business Intelligence Contract: Indefinite Duration Working Hours: Monday –Friday, 9:00 am – 5:30 pm About Medguard At Medguard, every role matters. Whether you're in logistics, customer service, education, or operations, your work helps deliver the exceptional service that exceeds our customer’s expectations. We’re a proudly Irish-founded company based in Ashbourne, Co. Meath — and one of Ireland’s leading suppliers of medical devices and consumables. Our success is built on strong relationships, mutual respect, and a shared commitment to enhancing patient care. Looking for your next opportunity? Join a team where your contribution counts, your growth is supported, and your work makes a difference. About the Role The Business Systems Analyst is responsible for supporting the day-to-day management, maintenance, and optimisation of Medguard's business systems, reporting processes, and data integrity across the organisation. This role supports operational teams through accurate reporting, system administration, data management, and process documentation, while helping ensure consistency and efficiency across key business platforms and integrations. Working closely with stakeholders across Sales, Customer Service, Purchasing, Operations, Finance, and Leadership, the Business Systems Analyst provides actionable insights, supports business reporting needs, maintains data quality, and identifies opportunities to improve processes and automate routine activities. Principal Duties and Responsibilities Business Systems Administration Support day-to-day administration of NetSuite and other business systems. Maintain master data and ensure data accuracy across systems. Support user access, role management, and data governance controls. Monitor system performance and escalate issues where necessary. Support testing and implementation of system enhancements and updates. Reporting and Business Intelligence Create, maintain, and continuously improve operational and management reports. Support the Digital Transformation Lead to: Develop and maintain dashboards and KPI reporting across departments. Produce regular and ad hoc reports to support business decision-making. Analyse business data and trends to identify opportunities for performance improvement. Present findings in a clear and actionable format to stakeholders. Data Management and Integrity Manage and monitor data imports, exports, and integrations between systems. Conduct data validation, cleaning, and integrity checks. Ensure consistency and accuracy of business data across platforms. Investigate and resolve data discrepancies. Support data governance and quality improvement initiatives. Process Improvement and Documentation Identify opportunities to streamline processes and automation. Document and maintain SOPs, workflows, and reporting procedures. Support continuous improvement projects across operational functions. Assist in the implementation of new tools, processes, and technologies. Monitor recurring integrations and escalate issues where necessary. Stakeholder Support Act as a key point of contact for departmental reporting and data requests. Work closely with cross-functional teams to understand processes and related information requirements. Provide training and guidance on business systems and reporting tools where appropriate. Support operational teams in making data-driven decisions. Adherence to GDP Guidelines (2013/C343/01) Ensure all activities comply with GDP requirements for the storage, handling, and distribution of products. Maintain awareness of regulatory standards and apply them consistently in daily operations. Other Duties Perform other duties as required per business needs. Required Experience and Qualifications Essential Degree in Business Information Systems, Data Analytics, Computer Science, Business, Statistics, or a related discipline. Experience supporting business systems, ERP platforms, reporting functions, or data analysis activities. Advanced Excel skills, including formulas, PivotTables, lookups, dashboards, data validation, and analysis. Experience creating and maintaining reports, dashboards, and operational performance metrics. Experience using Power BI or similar business intelligence and visualisation tools. Working knowledge of SQL and database concepts. Experience working with large datasets, including data validation, cleansing, and integrity management. Strong analytical, problem-solving, and data management skills, with the ability to identify trends and provide actionable insights. Strong attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy. Ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Excellent organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines. Ability to work independently and collaboratively within cross-functional teams. Desirable Experience working with NetSuite or other ERP systems. Experience supporting system integrations, data imports, exports, and interfaces. Experience documenting business processes, SOPs, and system procedures. Experience identifying and implementing process improvements or automation opportunities. Project management experience or qualifications (Agile, Scrum, PRINCE2, PMP, etc.). Experience working within project teams, sprint cycles, or continuous improvement initiatives. Familiarity with data modelling and reporting architecture. Benefits 22 Days Annual Leave – Because work-life balance matters. €250 Health & Wellness Subsidy – Invest in your well-being, on us. Group Pension Plan – 2% company match with New Ireland Assurance. Death in Service Benefit – Peace of mind with 2x basic salary coverage. Employee Assistance Programme – Confidential support when you need it. €250 Holiday Bonus Voucher – A little extra for your next getaway. Access to HSF Health Plan – Affordable healthcare for you and your family. Sports & Social – Because we like to have fun too! Learning & Development Opportunities – Grow your skills with access to training, upskilling, and career development support. Join the Team Behind the Mission at Medguard – Apply Today! Closing Date: 6 September 2026
title: Business Systems Analyst

description: Department: Billing Employment Type: Full time Location: Hybrid - Sandyford, Dublin 18 Salary: 45-50k OTE The Business Process & Improvement Analyst maps current working practices end to end — across billing assurance, exception handling, collections and payment arrangements — to give us a single, accurate view of how work flows. From that baseline, the role owns a quarterly roadmap of process improvements, worked jointly with the internal development team to increase automation, reduce manual effort, lift team capacity and output, and minimise operational and regulatory risk. The role also builds a centralised reporting view covering management information (MI) and daily operational work queues. Key Responsibilities Process Mapping & Improvement Assess and document current working practices end to end, capturing all process steps and touch points across the operational streams using appropriate process mapping tools. Identify inefficiencies, manual effort and control gaps, and translate them into prioritised improvement opportunities. Develop and own a quarterly roadmap of process improvements with the internal development team, targeting increased automation, reduced manual effort, greater capacity and lower operational and regulatory risk and facilitate workshops to validate current state maps, agree target-state designs and secure sign-off. Centralised Reporting & MI Design, build and maintain a centralised reporting view covering management information and daily operational work queues, using tools including Power BI and SQL to track key performance across billing and collections. Own data quality within reporting outputs (source validation and reconciliation against the system of record), provide data-driven recommendations and track adoption. description: Company Description Dil Foods, through its Dil Brands portfolio, creates and operates virtual food brands designed to address daily meal needs across India. By partnering with small and medium-sized restaurants, Dil Brands helps increase utilization of existing kitchen assets, staff, and resources. This model enables restaurant partners to reach new customer segments and grow revenue without significant additional investment. Team members at Dil Foods contribute to building scalable, tech-enabled food brands while supporting local businesses and improving access to convenient, quality meals. As the Brand Growth Manager, you will own the growth and performance of assigned brands within the Dil Foods portfolio. You will be responsible for metrics such as orders, revenue, AOV (average order value), repeat rate, brand recall and brand visibility — and will partner closely with menu, pricing, product, marketing and operations teams to drive scale, profitability and consumer engagement. Key Responsibilities A. Brand Growth & Performance Management •Own growth metrics (orders, revenue, AOV, repeat rate, etc.) for your assigned brands across existing and new platforms. •Analyse brand performance using platform dashboards, internal data and market intelligence to identify growth levers and improvement areas. •Design and execute marketing & discounting strategies in coordination with central marketing and finance teams to drive conversions and optimise ROI. •Manage aggregator and other channel relationships (e.g., Swiggy, Zomato, ONDC etc) to negotiate better visibility slots, campaigns and collaborations. B. Menu, Product & Pricing Strategy •Continuously analyse competitor menus to identify trends, pricing benchmarks and opportunity gaps. •Provide suggestive direction and ensure execution with the menu‑engineering / R&D teams — recommend or execute new item introductions, combos or limited‑time offers to boost excitement and relevance. •Work with the menu‑engineering team to build plans and ensure execution that focus on high‑margin, high‑performing SKUs and rationalise underperformers. •Work with culinary/R&D teams to localise offerings based on regional preferences or consumer feedback. •Collaborate with R&D and menu‑engineering on base pricing, packaging charges etc., to ensure competitiveness yet profitability across different city‑tiers and platforms. C. Growth Experimentation & Insights •Run A/B experiments on menu design, promotions and campaign creatives to drive data‑backed improvements. •Monitor and interpret consumer feedback (ratings, reviews, NPS) to refine brand communication and product quality. •Track competitor activity, special occasions, festivals and category‑level performance to anticipate trends and respond swiftly. •Use insights from performance data from Swiggy / Zomato to continuously improve the brand’s visibility, conversion and retention strategy. D. Cross‑Functional Collaboration (Critical & Mandatory) •Work closely with Operations, Culinary, Marketing, Finance and Tech teams to ensure seamless brand execution and alignment with growth objectives. •Provide actionable insights to leadership on category performance, consumer behaviour and brand positioning. E. New Brand Development (Beyond Day‑to‑Day – Opportunities to Expand Skills) •Identify white spaces and unmet consumer needs across cuisines, price points and geographies. Prepare business plans for leadership review backed with numbers and feasibility study. •Conceptualise and launch new brands tailored to specific markets or emerging trends in collaboration with culinary, design and operations teams. •Create go‑to‑market (GTM) strategies for new brand roll‑outs, ensuring rapid scale‑up and efficient utilisation of existing kitchen infrastructure. •Monitor performance of new brands post‑launch, ensuring scalability and profitability milestones are met. Candidate Profile •2-4 years’ experience in growth / performance / brand / preferably in the food‑tech / startup / QSR / aggregator fast-paced ecosystem. •Strong analytical mindset, comfortable working with dashboards, A/B tests, consumer‑data, and deriving actionable insights. •Experience with aggregator platforms (Swiggy, Zomato, etc) or digital food‑delivery businesses is a plus. •Understanding of menu engineering, pricing strategy and margin optimisation in F&B. •Excellent collaboration and stakeholder‑management skills to partner across functions. •Entrepreneurial mindset, willing to experiment and launch new brands/initiatives. •Ability to work in a fast‑paced, start‑up / scale‑up environment. Why Join Dil Foods Opportunity to be part of a fast‑growing company that is redefining how regional Indian cuisines are brought to consumers. •Ownership of brand growth end‑to‑end as a mini entrepreneur, product to pricing, visibility to performance. •Exposure across functions (menu, operations, marketing, tech) and the chance to launch new ideas and scale them.
title: Brand Growth Manager

description: Der Tagesspiegel zählt als Leitmedium aus der pulsierenden Hauptstadt zu den meistzitierten Zeitungen Deutschlands. Mit über 14 Millionen Online-Leser:innen und der höchsten verkauften Auflage in der Hauptstadtregion sind wir weit mehr als nur ein reichweitenstarkes Qualitätsmedium – wir sind ein dynamisches Medienhaus, das kontinuierlich wächst und sich weiterentwickelt. Unsere Redaktion und unser Verlag setzen auf Innovation, um den Herausforderungen des Medienmarktes mit frischen, kreativen Ideen zu begegnen. Neben Qualitätsinhalten in Print, Online, Audio und Video bieten wir ein vielfältiges Veranstaltungs- und Konferenzgeschäft, das unser multimediales Angebot perfekt ergänzt. Als stolzes Mitglied der DvH Medien GmbH von Dieter von Holtzbrinck stehen wir in einer Reihe mit angesehenen Leitmedien wie der Zeit, dem Handelsblatt und der WirtschaftsWoche. Bei uns arbeiten leidenschaftliche kreative Köpfe zusammen, die eine gemeinsame Vision für die Zukunft des Journalismus teilen. Werde Teil unseres engagierten Teams und gestalte mit uns die Medienlandschaft von morgen! Tagesspiegel Background ist das B2B-Fachinformationsprodukt des Tagesspiegels: professionelle Briefings und Politikmonitoring für Ministerien, Verbände, Kanzleien und Unternehmen, im Jahreslizenz-Abo. Für unser Produktteam suchen wir eine Person, die Geschäfts- und Produktdaten zusammenführt und daraus belastbare Entscheidungsgrundlagen macht. Die Rolle verbindet klassisches Reporting mit Produktanalytik und ist bewusst breit angelegt – Du entwickelst unser Reporting weiter, untersuchst Nutzung und Geschäftsentwicklung und gestaltest mit, wie wir Nutzung messen, bewerten und in Produktentscheidungen übersetzen. Du ziehst also nicht nur ein Reporting, wenn danach gefragt wird. Du fragst auch selbst: Was hat sich verändert? Warum könnte das so sein? Welche weiteren Daten oder qualitativen Erkenntnisse brauchen wir, um die Hypothese zu prüfen? Eine der Fragen, denen Du nachgehst: Welche Nutzungsmuster sagen Vertragsverlängerungen oder -kündigungen am besten voraus? Du arbeitest im Produktteam, eng mit Produktentwicklung, Growth, Vertrieb und Redaktion, sowie mit dem zentralen Datenteam des Verlags, bei dem Betrieb und Datenpipelines liegen. Für einzelne Fragestellungen arbeitest Du eigenständig mit den Rohdaten; was dauerhaft laufen soll, entsteht gemeinsam mit dem Datenteam. Das sind Deine Aufgaben: Du verantwortest unser Reporting in Power BI auf Basis von Salesforce und dem Data Warehouse – Umsatz, Kundenentwicklung, Retention, Forecasts – entwickelst es weiter und sorgst für einheitliche, dokumentierte Kennzahlendefinitionen, etwa rund um Abwanderung im Lizenzgeschäft Du definierst gemeinsam mit Produktentwicklung, Marketing und Growth, welche Ereignisse wir messen, und führst Daten aus Webtracking, E-Mail-Versand, Landingpages und CRM über die verschiedenen Quellsysteme hinweg zu einer konsistenten Account-Sicht zusammen Du erkennst relevante Veränderungen und Auffälligkeiten in unseren Daten, formulierst Hypothesen und untersuchst sie eigenständig. Dabei bleibst du nicht bei der ersten plausiblen Erklärung stehen, sondern prüfst alternative Ursachen und die Aussagekraft der Datenbasis Du entwickelst Analysen zur Nutzung unserer Website und unseres Produkts weiter – zum Beispiel zu Aktivierung, Engagement, Nutzungstiefe und Verlängerungswahrscheinlichkeit. Du leitest daraus konkrete nächste Untersuchungen oder Handlungsempfehlungen ab Du legst bei neuen Funktionen und Produkten vor dem Launch fest, woran wir Erfolg messen, und wertest nach dem Rollout aus, was sich bewährt hat, für wen und unter welchen Bedingungen Du bereitest Deine Ergebnisse für Redaktion, Vertrieb und Geschäftsführung so auf, dass sie als Entscheidungsgrundlage taugen – methodisch sauber, zielgruppengerecht und inklusive der Aussagegrenzen der jeweiligen Datenbasis Das bringst Du mit: Etwa drei bis fünf Jahre Erfahrung in Product Analytics oder Business Intelligence – beides zusammen ist willkommen, aber keine Voraussetzung. Ein Abo-, Medien- oder B2B-SaaS-Umfeld ist von Vorteil Sehr sichere SQL-Kenntnisse auf einem Cloud-Warehouse (z. B. BigQuery, Snowflake, Redshift oder Databricks) und Erfahrung mit einem BI-Werkzeug, bei uns Power BI Fundierte Erfahrung mit Web- und Produktanalytik, inklusive GA4 auf Rohdatenebene. Erfahrung im Entwurf eigener Tracking-Konzepte ist von Vorteil Du definierst, erklärst und vertrittst Kennzahlen sicher, ordnest ein, was eine Zahl aussagt und was nicht, und leitest daraus nächste Schritte ab Du arbeitest hypothesengetrieben und beharrlich. Wenn ein Signal interessant ist, gehst Du ihm nach, bis Du Ursachen, Unsicherheiten und Konsequenzen möglichst klar voneinander trennen kannst Du arbeitest reproduzierbar, sodass andere Deine Auswertungen nachvollziehen und weiterführen können Du nutzt KI-Werkzeuge selbstverständlich, prüfst deren Ergebnisse jedoch sorgfältig, bevor Du sie weitergibst Du verfügst über verhandlungssichere Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift Von Vorteil, aber kein Muss: Erfahrung mit einem CRM-System als Datenquelle, idealerweise Salesforce Kenntnisse in Python oder R Erfahrung mit Kundeninterviews oder Nutzerforschung Verständnis für Abo- und Lizenzmodelle Das bieten wir Dir: Kreativer Freiraum in einem Team, in dem Ideen geschätzt werden und Du Deine Visionen in einem innovativen Medienunternehmen im Herzen Berlins umsetzen kannst Flache Hierarchien mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen und direkter Kommunikation Bezuschusstes BVG-Firmenticket und Zuschuss zur betrieblichen Altersvorsorge Kostenloses Digital-Abonnement von Tagesspiegel & Tagesspiegel Plus, Handelsblatt und die Zeit Möglichkeiten zur beruflichen Weiterentwicklung durch die Online-Plattform Masterplan, um Deine Karriere voranzutreiben Eine 38,5-Stunden-Woche mit 30 Tagen Urlaub (bei einer Vollzeitstelle), damit Du ausreichend Zeit hast, um Dich zu erholen Flexible Arbeitszeiten und mobiles Arbeiten bis zu 50% Jede Nachricht erzählt eine eigene Geschichte – und so ist es auch mit den Menschen, die bei uns arbeiten. Beim Tagesspiegel schätzen wir die Vielfalt unserer Mitarbeiterinnen und Mitarbeiter und sind fest davon überzeugt, dass unterschiedliche Perspektiven unsere Arbeit bereichern. Wir setzen uns für Chancengleichheit ein und fördern einen respektvollen Umgang miteinander. Unabhängig von Herkunft, Geschlecht, Religion, Alter oder sexueller Identität – bei uns bist Du willkommen. Lass uns gemeinsam ein inspirierendes Arbeitsumfeld schaffen, in dem jeder seine Einzigartigkeit einbringen kann! Du denkst, wir sollten uns kennenlernen? Wenn Du bereit bist, Deine Fähigkeiten in einem inspirierenden Team einzusetzen und einen echten Unterschied zu machen, dann bewirb Dich jetzt über unser Bewerbungsportal https://verlagsjobs.tagesspiegel.de/ und sende uns Deine Bewerbungsunterlagen. Gemeinsam erzählen wir Geschichten, die bewegen! Wir freuen uns darauf, Dich kennenzulernen!

description: Intro Adsquare's mission is centered on: Passion: Solving complex challenges with exceptional people, technology, and data. Niche: Specializing in Location Intelligence for Programmatic Advertisers. Our work is guided by our core values, and we look for candidates who embody them: Drive: Turning ambition into action that brings valuable outcomes. Resilience: Adapting, persevering, and growing stronger through challenges. No BS: Upholding honesty, transparency, and clear communication. Humble: Valuing modesty and letting results speak for themselves. Moral Compass: Acting with fairness, integrity, and respect. About the team You'll join Adsquare's Data Products team, responsible for the pipelines and signals that power our Location Intelligence solutions. Working closely with our Lead PM for Data Products and a squad of data engineers, you'll help ingest, process, and scale the supplier and panel data that fuels our products. Your squad sits at the intersection of engineering, data governance, and downstream teams like Measurement and Activation, ensuring the signals we deliver are fast, reliable, and trustworthy. Your Mission As Product Owner for SDV Data Products (f/m/d), you'll own your squad's delivery, turning strategy into clear, testable backlog items while managing the technical scale of our core data pipelines. You'll be the primary technical counterpart to our data suppliers and panel partners, driving the operational reliability that keeps our signals fresh and trusted. Your Profile 3-5 years of experience as a Product Owner or technical PM, ideally in AdTech, MarTech, or another data-heavy ecosystem. Strong at managing delivery and technical scale: sequencing complex backend work, mapping dependencies, and scoping against time, whether working with engineers, architects, or integration teams. Operationally rigorous: comfortable thinking in SLIs, SLOs, freshness, match rate, and MTTR, not just features shipped, and skilled at running a tight, testable backlog. Data-fluent, with required SQL proficiency: able to independently query internal data sources to investigate supplier data, panel quality, and pipeline KPIs, and bring quantified evidence into prioritisation. Comfortable with ambiguity: able to make decisions with limited information and translate business intent clearly for engineering. A privacy-aware product thinker who understands data governance and how evolving privacy frameworks affect upstream ingestion and pipeline logic. A clear communicator across altitudes, able to translate strategy into specs and engineering reality into product trade-offs. A true owner who drives outcomes without step-by-step direction and surfaces tensions upward rather than resolving them quietly. What you will do Own and maintain your squad's backlog, working closely with the Lead PM for Data Products to translate strategy into clear, testable user stories. Lead the roadmap for modernising, scaling, and optimising our core data ingestion and processing pipelines to handle high-throughput workloads. Manage internal dependencies — SLAs, schema contracts, and joint roadmap touchpoints — with downstream squads such as Measurement, Activation, and Data Products. Coordinate releases of new schemas, ingestion endpoints, match logic changes, and signal product enhancements. Act as the primary PO-level counterpart to data supplier and panel partner technical teams, co-owning ingestion specs and schema contracts. Support the Lead PM on new supplier partnerships and panel expansion through feasibility input, integration scoping, and prototype delivery. Define, own, and report on operational KPIs such as signal freshness, SLA adherence, panel coverage, schema validation pass rate, and match rate. Establish SLIs, SLOs, and escalation paths in partnership with engineering, and own the operational visibility layer (dashboards, alerts) that surfaces data product health. Nice to Have Based in Berlin, or open to working from our Berlin office periodically. Prior experience collaborating directly with identity vendors, panel providers, or purchase-data suppliers on schema and integration work. Our Software Stack SQL Jira Confluence API Documentation tools Why us? On top of a competitive package… We are open to flexible work models: we work in a hybrid mode. To encourage education and professional growth, we offer an individual yearly budget of €1,200. You are entitled to 30 vacation days per year. Public transport contribution. We care about your mental health and provide coaching and counseling sessions through our collaboration with the Fürstenberg Institut. We equip you with the latest hardware and all the tools you need to thrive. Salary Range (Annual On-Target Earnings) 65,000 - 70,000 euros Recruiting Process HR interview — values-based (30 min) VP Product interview (45 min) Case study interview (1 hour) Team interview (30 min) Offer Work model: Hybrid
title: Product Owner – SDV Data Products (f/m/d)

description: About Us STARK is a new kind of defence technology company revolutionising the way autonomous systems are deployed across multiple domains. We design, develop, and manufacture high-performance unmanned systems that are software-defined, mass-scalable, and cost-effective — providing operators with a decisive edge in contested environments. We are focused on delivering deployable, high-performance systems — not future promises. In a time of rising threats, STARK is bolstering the technological edge of NATO Allies and their Partners to deter aggression and defend Europe, today. About the team At the heart of our robotic platforms are robust sensor networks and reliable operating systems. As a Robotics Product Owner, you will be the vital link between high-level system requirements and daily engineering execution. Your mission You will guide a cross-functional team of hardware and software engineers through a rapidly growing portfolio of projects. By taking inputs from system engineers and program managers, you will ensure the team always has clear, actionable, and prioritized work, while keeping the broader organization informed of our technical capabilities. Responsibilities Translate Needs: Work closely with system engineers and program managers to break down complex system requirements into clear, actionable user stories and acceptance criteria for the engineering team. Push the Backlog: Regularly align with the team lead to manage and prioritize the team's backlog across the hardware and software stack, balancing long-term foundational architecture with immediate project milestones. Drive Execution: Facilitate daily alignment across the team—from hardware engineers working on optics and supplier specs, to software engineers building out embedded systems and sensor overlays—to unblock work and keep sprints moving smoothly. Document Capabilities: Maintain clear, accessible, and up-to-date documentation of our technical capabilities, system resources, and sprint outcomes so stakeholders always know what the team can deliver. Evaluate & Accept Work: Review completed engineering work against requirements, navigating collaborative trade-offs when friction arises between hardware constraints, embedded software performance, and project timelines. Qualifications Experience: 3+ years of experience as a Technical Product Manager, or similar roles, specifically working on hardware-software integrated products, robotics, IoT, or complex technical platforms. Technical Literacy: You are comfortable reviewing technical structures, navigating code repositories on GitLab, and collaborating effectively with software engineers. Systems Thinking: A solid understanding of the robotics and embedded tech stack. You should feel comfortable discussing sensor calibration, edge computing (like Jetson platforms), driver integration, and overall system architecture. Communication: Exceptional ability to communicate complex concepts clearly, acting as the bridge between deeply technical engineers and higher-level program managers. Nice to have Familiarity with sensor hardware lifecycles and optics. Experience with embedded Linux, Jetson carrier boards, or base image configuration. Experience with Agile frameworks in a hardware context. Previous experience working in the defense, aerospace, or autonomous vehicle sectors. We know that great candidates come from diverse backgrounds. If you don't have these exact qualifications but feel you could succeed in this role, please apply anyway. For further information please reach out to talent@stark-defence.com. SECURITY CLEARANCE Due to the nature of our work in the defence sector, candidates must be eligible to obtain and maintain the appropriate security clearance required for this position. Details will be provided during the recruitment process. EQUAL OPPORTUNITY We are an equal-opportunity employer committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, national origin, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

description: About ZOCA We are at $2.5Mn+ ARR, 1000+ beauty and wellness businesses on the platform, and a $6M Series A behind us. We are not starting out. But we are also nowhere close to where we want to be. Zoca is building the growth infrastructure that small beauty and wellness businesses have never had access to. Online visibility, bookings, payments, customer retention, voice AI. We want people who will think, challenge, ship, and own outcomes. Why this role exists There are roughly 8.5 million local service businesses in the United States. Almost every tool ever built for them helps run the business. Almost none of them brings anyone through the door. Zoca is a growth system for those businesses, starting with beauty and wellness. More than 1,000 businesses use it today. We are backed by Accel, Elevation Capital, Better Capital, and GTM Fund. We are the only company in our category that sells growth itself. Everyone else sells booking and payments, which is a very different promise and a much easier one to keep. That makes this role unusually direct. What you spend has to come back as revenue somebody can point at. What You Will Own Paid acquisition end to end. Strategy input, daily operations, and budget allocation across Meta, Google, and YouTube. Creative velocity. Enough tested variants every month that we actually learn something. You will not be making them yourself. We have a full-time creative whose largest single output is your ad creative, so you are not going to be blocked on a freelancer. The measurement stack. GA4, GTM, offline conversion imports, CRM hygiene, and one funnel dashboard leadership trusts. This is a deliverable, not a favor, and it is written into the role on purpose. Landing page and funnel conversion, working with content and product. Feeding paid data back into our outbound machine so that lead scoring gets sharper over time. Your first 90 days Audit every dollar we have historically spent and tell us plainly what worked and what did not. We would rather hear it early and blunt. Rebuild tracking so a lead can be followed from click to closed revenue without anyone arguing about the number. Run a structured creative test of at least 40 variants against our core customer. Get one channel under a six-month payback on gross margin, with attribution good enough that the result is believable. What We Are Looking For 4 - 6 years running paid acquisition, with meaningful time on a United States audience. B2B SaaS, SMB, or D2C are all fine. Genuine curiosity about small business owners is not optional, because our customer is a salon owner with three staff and no time. You have personally built tracking and attribution, not just consumed dashboards somebody else built. You think in payback and contribution margin. If cost per click is the first number you reach for, we will not work well together. You have real opinions about creative and can brief an editor properly. You can say a channel is not working while it is still your channel. This matters more to us than being right the first time. What This Is Not Not a job managing agencies. Not a job where a team executes while you review. You will be in the accounts. If you have spent the last two years approving other people's work, you will find this frustrating rather than freeing. How To Apply No cover letter. Do this instead. It should take under two hours and we read every one. Pick any company selling to med spas or salons in the United States. Build a six-week creative testing plan for a $20,000 monthly budget aimed at owners with two or more employees. Show us the payback math you would need to see to keep going, what you would kill in week two, and one measurement mistake you are fairly confident that company is already making. One page, or one short recording if you would rather talk than write. We reply to everyone who does the exercise, including the people we do not move forward with. Zoca is an equal opportunity employer. Compensation is total CTC and includes a variable component tied to payback-qualified leads delivered. If you are excited by the role but unsure you meet every line, apply anyway and let the exercise speak. Skills: crm hygiene,paid acquisition,b2b saas
